response.overview: EXTRAÑA follows a young woman, Sapphire Lechuga, who finds comfort and control in the precision and privacy of her daily routines. This balance is suddenly disrupted by a barking dog next door, whose constant noise fractures her focus and throws her routines into disarray. Sapphire sets out to quiet the dog, but the more she tries to restore order, the more chaotic her world becomes.
response.title: Extraña
